report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with ok results. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders at 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 facts. No evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off.
